# Weekly Status Decision-Readiness Delta

Use this template when a confidential status call, weekly update, project-room note, or steering-committee prep document contains many active workstreams but does not clearly answer whether the file is more ready for a decision than last week.

This is a `build-to-learn` concierge artifact. It is not a meeting summary, transcript, legal/compliance/procurement/tax/financial opinion, or project approval.

Use aliases by default. Do not include real company names, counterparty names, personal names, exact dates, deal values, site names, call times, or uniquely identifying sequences. See [`../trust/confidential-project-workflow.md`](../trust/confidential-project-workflow.md).

## Status-to-evidence conversion

Translate meeting/status language into evidence state.

| Status phrase or update | What it actually proves | What it does not prove | Evidence state |
|---|---|---|---|
| Follow-up sent | A message was sent | Counterparty intent, financing, approval, or commitment | activity-only |
| Proposal expected | A proposal may arrive | Price, comparability, deliverability, or compliance | pending |
| LOI received | Interest exists | Binding demand, volume, term, pricing, or budget owner | weak evidence |
| Meeting held | Topic was discussed | Decision, approval, or resolved blocker | activity-only |
| Tax/legal review ongoing | Owner is engaged | Applicability, clearance, or final treatment | unresolved |

## Boundary notes

- This delta does not approve or reject the project.
- This delta does not provide legal, compliance, procurement, security, tax, customs, financial, insurance, sanctions, export-control, or investment advice.
- This delta checks whether status updates changed the evidence state for a human decision.
- Meeting activity, follow-ups, expected proposals, and interest signals are not treated as commitments unless supported by source evidence.
